moodys.citation_text: Universe v2 records 'moodys: null'. Lawrence General not rated by Moody's per available coverage.

sp.citation_text: Becker's: 'S&P lowered Lawrence General Hospital from BB+ to BB' (Feb 2019) reflecting FY2015-2018 operating losses; stable outlook. No surfaced S&P action between Feb 2019 and the universe-v2 noted Oct 2024 'B- stable affirmed' state, implying BB was the carrying rating into the window start 2022-12-31. PARTIALLY VERIFIED: the BB to B- migration over 2019-2024 not pinned to specific intermediate actions.
sp._warning: Trajectory between 2019 BB and 2024 B- not fully reconstructed; intermediate S&P actions (likely 1-2 notches down during 2020-2023) not surfaced.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: S&P at B-/Stable per universe v2 ('2024-10 B- stable affirmed'). This represents either continued operation at B- (affirmation) or further notch down from prior B/B+; intermediate action(s) not pinned.
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Lawrence General's vulnerable financial profile persisted; October 2024 acquisition of Holy Family hospitals from defunct Steward Health Care ($28M Bankruptcy Court-approved transaction, closed October 1, 2024) added 1,300+ employees and 2 community hospitals. Operating losses continued.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: S&P disclosure index URL exists for 'Lawrence General Hospital, MA Bond Rating Outlook' indicating an S&P action exists for this period. Universe v2 captures 'B- stable affirmed' state as of Oct 2024.

sp.citation_text: B-/Stable per universe v2 'sp: B-, 2024-10 B- stable affirmed'. Stamford-side trade press did not surface a fresh action between Oct 2024 and 2025-03-31.

outcome_class_rationale: Trajectory BB (2022-12-31) -> B- (2024-10-31) implies at least 4 notches down (BB -> BB- -> B+ -> B -> B-) during the window. Even if some downgrades occurred just before window-start, the bulk of degradation occurred 2022-2024. This is a clear MULTI_DOWNGRADE pattern. Note: classification taxonomy doesn't formally include 'DEFAULT' bucket here because Lawrence General did NOT file Chapter 11; instead, it consummated the Steward hospital acquisition (Oct 2024) and rebranded as Merrimack Health (2025). The B- credit nonetheless trades like a deep-distressed BBB-tier fallen angel.
